title: Igname Pilée
description: Igname Pilée is a Benin classic prepared with yam, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 30 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 15 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
